title: Put your goods in
headline: Put your *goods* in
sub: Photos, sizes and colours: one product, not thirty rows.

recap.en: Zuri Atelier is open. Time to stock it.
recap.pcm: Shop don open. Make we stock am.

flow.action: Photographs a finished green-and-gold Ankara dress on a mannequin with her phone, steps back, checks the picture and smiles
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall

flow.action: Her phone buzzes on the cutting table; she picks it up, reads, her brows lift, and she looks up with a determined smile
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall
flow.camera: close-up on her face, shallow depth of field

bridge.en: A message arrives: Nneka needs an outfit by Saturday. How does Zainab take her order?
bridge.pcm: Message enter: Nneka need outfit by Saturday. How Zainab go take her order?

en: Zainab lists the dresses she sells.
She opens Products, then Add product.
She types the name, picks Dresses, and adds the price.
Add product. The dress is in.
To sell it in sizes and colours, she opens the dress.
Colours: green, gold, blue. The grid appears.
She fills in the counts, then changes one.
Save. Twelve sizes and colours, on sale.
pcm: She open Products, then Add product.
She type the name, pick Dresses, and add the price.
Add product. The dress don enter.
To sell am for sizes and colours, she open the dress.
Colours: green, gold, blue. The grid show.
She fill the counts, then change one.
Save. Twelve sizes and colours, ready to sell.
